title: Mob Rods
description: A Minecraft Paper plugin that gives players fishing rods to spawn mobs.
body:
## Features

- `/mobrod <mob>` - Get a fishing rod that spawns 30 mobs in a 15-block radius
- Right-click or reel the rod to spawn mobs instantly
- Rod breaks after one use
- Special Wolf Rod: Wolves are tamed, armored, and have Speed II + Strength II

## Permissions

- `mobrod.use` - Allows use of the /mobrod command (default: op)

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Paper server
